TREVPAR_WEEK.label: Weekly TRevPAR
TREVPAR_WEEK.meaning: Weekly total revenue per available room.

TAXA_OCUPACAO.label: Occupancy rate
TAXA_OCUPACAO.meaning: Percentage of available room capacity occupied.

N_REVIEWS.label: Number of reviews
N_REVIEWS.meaning: Number of reviews associated with the hotel-week.

SENTIMENT_SCORE_AVG.label: Average sentiment
SENTIMENT_SCORE_AVG.meaning: Average sentiment score extracted from review text.

EXPECTATION_EXPERIENCE_GAP_AVG.label: Expectation–experience gap
EXPECTATION_EXPERIENCE_GAP_AVG.meaning: Average discrepancy between expressed expectations and reported experience.

SEMANTIC_MISALIGNMENT_SCORE_AVG.label: Semantic misalignment
SEMANTIC_MISALIGNMENT_SCORE_AVG.meaning: Average semantic divergence between expectations and reported experience.

EXPECTATION_VIOLATION_RATIO.label: Expectation violation ratio
EXPECTATION_VIOLATION_RATIO.meaning: Share or ratio of expectation-related observations classified as violated.

MAJOR_MISALIGNMENT_SHARE.label: Major misalignment share
MAJOR_MISALIGNMENT_SHARE.meaning: Share of reviews or review structures showing major expectation–experience misalignment.

EMOTION_ENTROPY.label: Emotional complexity
EMOTION_ENTROPY.meaning: Entropy-based heterogeneity of emotions expressed across reviews.

EXPECTATION_SHARE.label: Expectation share
EXPECTATION_SHARE.meaning: Share of reviews containing identifiable expectations.

HIGH_EXPECTATION_SHARE.label: High-expectation share
HIGH_EXPECTATION_SHARE.meaning: Share of reviews containing high-intensity expectations.

HIGH_MISALIGNMENT_SHARE.label: High-misalignment share
HIGH_MISALIGNMENT_SHARE.meaning: Share of observations with high semantic misalignment.

PERC_REVIEWS_NEGATIVE.label: Reviews containing negative/disliked content
PERC_REVIEWS_NEGATIVE.meaning: Percentage of reviews containing a negative or disliked text component. It does not mean that the full review or numerical rating is negative.
PERC_REVIEWS_NEGATIVE.critical_interpretation_warning: Do not interpret this variable as the percentage of guests giving a negative overall evaluation.

PERC_OPERATIONAL_COMPLAINTS.label: Operational complaint share
PERC_OPERATIONAL_COMPLAINTS.meaning: Percentage of complaint content associated with operational or service-delivery issues.

PERC_PRICE_VALUE_MENTIONS.label: Price–value mention share
PERC_PRICE_VALUE_MENTIONS.meaning: Percentage of review content mentioning price or perceived value.

POLARIZATION_INDEX.label: Review polarization
POLARIZATION_INDEX.meaning: Degree to which review experiences are divided or polarized.

COMPLEXITY_INDEX.label: Experience complexity index
COMPLEXITY_INDEX.meaning: Composite indicator of heterogeneous and layered customer experience signals.

SENTIMENT_TREND_SLOPE.label: Precomputed sentiment trend slope
SENTIMENT_TREND_SLOPE.meaning: Trend slope calculated previously in the source panel. Do not confuse it with the case-window trend recalculated by the Case Builder.

topic_summary.interpretation_note: Topic-source metrics must be interpreted separately. experience_weeks may include positive or neutral experiences. violated_expectation_weeks and emerging_negative_weeks indicate negative evidence. negative_review_mentions are based only on review_text_disliked. Cross-structure topic occurrences may refer to the same underlying issue and are not independent complaints.

review_sample_metadata.selection_strategy: Neutral recent-review sampling. Reviews are ordered by review_date descending and the most recent reviews are selected. No filtering or ranking based on rating, sentiment, complaint severity or text length is used.
review_sample_metadata.interpretation_warning: The sample represents the most recent reviews in the decision window, not necessarily the full review distribution.

complaints.title: Disappointing
complaints.complaint_text: Disliked: The bathroom had a sticker on the wall that wasn't removed. There was dust under the desk The walls are paper thin and can hear everything going on in the next room When you ring reception after 9pm due to limited staff the phone isn't answered, so when we needed to complain about the noise no one would pick up. When you ask for something like milk for the coffee we were told they don't have milk and to go to the shop down the road to get some- not in a polite way either The wardrobe didn't have any doors We put a please clean my room sign outside and asked for our room to be cleaned when we'd left. When we returned the room hadn't been cleaned and we were told by reception that we had a DND sign up. I checked whilst on the phone and it was definitely clean the room. After several calls and over a 30 minute wait we were then provided with the things we needed for the next morning. Quite disappointed as we were checking out that day, so left us not holding the hotel with much regard. We wouldn't stay here again.

complaints.title: Suportável
complaints.complaint_text: Disliked: The suites are old, we had to ask to change rooms; first they put us on the 5th floor, the bad smell on that floor could be noticed when getting off the elevator. The bad smell in the bathroom was unbearable. We asked to change and they put us on the 4th floor, it was better, it had no smell. We needed a suite; we had tried to book at other hotels, but they were full. If we hadn't had so much luggage, we certainly would have changed hotels. Some hotels put photos on their sites but do not reveal what they really are. I didn't take a photo because I didn't want to keep, not even in photos, the disappointment of our stay at this hotel.

complaints.title: L’hôtel est bien placé, le petit déjeuné était excellent mais je ne recommande pas cet hôtel car il ne correspond aux ph
complaints.complaint_text: Disliked: A disabled-access room was assigned to us without being informed, even though we had paid for a superior class room. The disabled room was located on the 6th floor and the elevator was not working... we had to use a service lift. The photos do not really match the room we selected and when we complained, another room was assigned to us for an extra charge for an inferior class room — never seen before!! The rooms do not have an outlet in the bathroom, no hygiene supplies as we are used to finding in 4-star hotels. For this last point, these are details but details that make a difference when we pay a substantial amount for a hotel considered a 4-star.

complaints.title: Como se diz em francês: ça va.
complaints.complaint_text: Disliked: I did not like the reception on arrival. I arrived around 10:00. I had to wait for a room to be available until 13:00; up to that point that's fine, since check-out is normally at 12:00. However, since I had already been waiting a long time, the two reception staff working the day of my arrival gave priority to more than five customers who arrived at 13:00. I found it disrespectful and an act of discrimination. The room's blackout curtain was torn, so the morning light entered the room early.

complaints.title: Komfortabeles, sehr sauberes, nicht ganz günstiges Hotelzimmer,
complaints.complaint_text: Disliked: The hotel is on a busy road and is therefore quite noisy. In addition, the metro apparently runs under the hotel, which is also very clearly audible. For us the location was a bit far from the old town and the sights (about a 40-minute walk). For those who like to take the subway this is certainly not a problem—the metro station is directly in front of the building. A major drawback for us was the parking situation (we had a rental car, as our trip was continuing). There was a public parking garage nearby open 24 hours where you could always find a space, but you pay about €20/day. The additional parking and breakfast costs (€15 per person) add up, so the price-performance ratio was rather suboptimal for us.

The breakfast buffet in the adjacent café was very good, especially the coffee. It was constantly replenished. We had not booked breakfast, but we were able to pay for it easily by credit card in the café.

They ran out of face towels.

complaint_metadata.selection_strategy: Complaint-focused diagnostic sampling. Only reviews with substantive content in review_text_disliked are eligible. Complaints are ranked by lower rating, longer disliked text and recency.
complaint_metadata.interpretation_warning: Selected complaints are diagnostic evidence and are not representative of the complete review distribution. Prevalence should be assessed using the full review-window metadata and managerial evidence.
